proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ n k A
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hA : (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) + A.card = Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_compl_add_card A
  have e2 : 1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω := by
    field_simp; linarith
  have e : Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (∀ j, j < k → ω j ∉ A) ∧ ω k ∈ A) = Fintype.piFinset (fun j => if j < k then Aᶜ else if j = k then A else Finset.univ) := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ j
      by_cases hj : j < k
      · rw [if_pos hj, Finset.mem_compl]; exact h1 j hj
      · rw [if_neg hj]
        by_cases hjk : j = k
        · rw [if_pos hjk, hjk]; exact h2
        · rw [if_neg hjk]; exact Finset.mem_univ _
    · intro hω
      refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := hω j
        rw [if_pos hj, Finset.mem_compl] at this
        exact this
      · have := hω k
        rwa [if_neg (lt_irrefl k), if_pos rfl] at this
  have hp : (∏ j : Fin n, ((if j < k then Aᶜ else if j = k then A else Finset.univ : Finset Ω).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) = ((Aᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) ^ (k : ℕ) * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) := by
    have s1 : ∀ j : Fin n, ((if j < k then Aᶜ else if j = k then A else Finset.univ : Finset Ω).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = (if j < k then (Aᶜ.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω else 1) * (if j = k then (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω else 1) := by
      intro j
      by_cases hj : j < k
      · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos hj, if_neg hj.ne, mul_one]
      · by_cases hjk : j = k
        · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj, if_pos hjk, if_pos hjk, one_mul]
        · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj, if_neg hjk, if_neg hjk, one_mul, Finset.card_univ, div_self h]
    rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => s1 j, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_ite_eq' Finset.univ k]
    rw [Finset.prod_ite, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one, Finset.prod_const]
    have : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => j < k)).card = (k : ℕ) := by
      rw [← Fin.card_Iio k]
      congr 1
      ext j
      simp
    rw [this]
    simp
  rw [e, Fintype.card_piFinset, e2, Nat.cast_prod, ← hp, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n) (A : Finset Ω), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => (∀ j, j < k → ω j ∉ A) ∧ ω k ∈ A)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) = (1 - (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) ^ (k : ℕ) * ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω)
